history.interpretation: Architecture inventory caught the new staging adapter. Reviewed its three allowed publisher calls; added an exact call guard and preserved exclusive physical/root ownership, rather than removing the ownership test. Later gates did not execute.

resources.behavior: One compiled configuration plus one COW path retained; fixed admitted staging scratch; hard refusal at every publication; actual definition-wrapper allocation refusal; deterministic retry and released leases.

proofBoundary: Fresh counted composition from one captured registry and previously qualified compiled configurations, not source capture or authorization. Complete selected-H dependency IDs deduplicate shared roles correctly. The extracted independent oracle checks catalog bytes; predecessor compiler conformance independently checks configuration bytes. Every present-object read and publication boundary is faulted in the storage-neutral harness. Actual physical publication, bounded read-back, reopen and idempotent retry are exercised without HEAD selection. Private error fixtures are category tests, not actual injected disk I/O. Native staging protection must be retained by its task/GC owner; this adapter does not create a durable task pin.
